items.title: Joe Mares Jr. Interview, 1960-04-08
items.q: Joe faded out. I brought Joe back also after 20 years' retirement.

ctx.x: cold or pneumonia. No, but he went into pneumonia. Right after that. That was it. Are there any more of those sessions that you want to go through? Any other things about?

Well, there's two or three other boys here. For instance, we take like Joe Capera. Back in the early 30s, Joe was one of the big names around New Orleans. In fact, he was the only one who had a band around here. Joe faded out. I brought Joe back also after 20 years' retirement. In my book, Joe's one of the greatest guitar boys in the business. He's a good rhythm boy. He knows what it's all about. Another fellow here I'd like to bring on is Charlie Cadela. Charlie and my brother Paul were very, very good friends.…
